$comment: Pulse config. `default_goal` is used when a run is triggered without an explicit goal (e.g. opening Pulse with no data on disk). `sites` toggles source tools (HN, Reddit, Lobsters, arxiv, RSS) + per-site config. `targets` toggles output lanes (x-post, blog, etc.) + per-lane config. Goals dispatch capabilities; capabilities call enabled sites and draft for enabled targets. Reddit is dual-role.
default_goal: Daily X-post if I shipped or learned something yesterday. Skip if nothing meaningful.
